Group Sequential Design

Start with vignette("gsDesignPackageOverview"). Derive a design, inspect its operating characteristics, and round the design for implementation.

Calibrating Spending to Interim Targets

Translate CP, predictive power, probability of success, or approximate treatment-effect targets into spending-function parameters. Start with vignette("CPFutilitySpending"), vignette("DragalinFutilitySpending"), or vignette("EffectSpending"). For conditional probability of success, gsCPOSFutilitySpending() supports both preserve-power and fixed-information modes; gsCAFutilitySpending() is the fixed-information compatibility wrapper.

gsCPFutilitySpending()
Calibrate Futility Spending to Conditional Power Targets
gsPPFutilitySpending()
Calibrate Futility Spending to Predictive Power Targets
gsEffectSpending()
Calibrate Spending to Natural-Scale Effects at Boundaries
gsPOSFutilitySpending()
Calibrate Futility Spending to Unconditional Probability of Success
gsCPOSFutilitySpending()
Calibrate Futility Spending to Conditional Probability of Success
gsCAFutilitySpending()
Calibrate Futility Spending at Fixed Information

Conditional Power and Probability of Success

Calculate CP and predictive power at an observed interim result, prior probability of success, or conditional probability of success given continuation. The shared gsCP() topic includes gsPP(), gsPOS(), gsCPOS(), gsPosterior(), and gsPI().

gsCP() gsPP() gsPI() gsPosterior() gsPOS() gsCPOS()

gsDensity()

Time-to-Event Design and Power

Use gsSurv() for information-driven designs, gsSurvCalendar() for calendar-time looks, and gsSurvPower() for power under a fixed plan. The shared gsSurv() topic includes nSurv(), nEventsIA(), and tEventsIA(). The earlier, more limited Lachin-Foulkes implementation and additional event-count and hazard-ratio conversions are documented in nSurvival().

tEventsIA() nEventsIA() nSurv() print(<nSurv>) xtable(<gsSurv>) gsSurv() print(<gsSurv>)
Advanced time-to-event sample size calculation
gsSurvCalendar()
Group sequential design with calendar-based timing of analyses
gsSurvPower()
Compute power for a group sequential survival design
print(<nSurvival>) nSurvival() nEvents() zn2hr() hrn2z() hrz2n()
Time-to-event sample size calculation (Lachin-Foulkes)
